raw.cause: camera answered five frame requests, then on the sixth (event 58318, received at 58328) camera_handle hit the camera-hang path and sat in pause() without ever calling MsgReply. display's main loop calls MsgSend to camera inline on thread 1, so it stays REPLY-blocked on camera forever (-58319) and never reaches nav or logger again. A send timeout would not help: the name_attach channel has _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK set and the wedged camera never handles the unblock pulse.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in display (main loop, blocking on camera); MsgReply missing in camera
raw.fix_summary: Take the camera call out of display's drawing thread. A dedicated reader thread does the MsgSend to camera, and the main loop only reads the last frame under a mutex, showing "camera stale" when it gets old. This is the existing COCKPIT_FIXED path; make it the only path rather than an env option. Do not rely on TimerTimeout around MsgSend, because of _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK. Separately, camera's hang is its own bug.

finding: camera stopped answering and took display down with it
